notes: Finding randomly placed things around a village is Adventure's Scavenger Hunt, and world-open is right because a big medieval village is one contiguous surface combed in whatever order the player likes. collectible-nodes carries the roughly twenty items the answers specified and alcove-secret puts them in the nooks between buildings so searching is an activity; I dropped tracker-quest since no board or posted objective was mentioned. settlement-density is the landing place for the request that actually shapes this map — a big rustic village rather than scattered huts — and it costs nothing on the pipeline. Without a user to check I assumed the items are found outdoors around the village rather than inside the houses, which keeps the build on P0; enterable interiors would add P3 and were not asked for.
